newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt pound overnight rates narrow.
newsitem.headline: Egypt pound overnight rates narrow.

text.p: Overnight interbank rates on the Egyptian pound narrowed in the private sector market on Monday to between 10-1/4 and 10-1/2 percent from Sunday's range of 9-7/8 and 10-1/2 percent, one banker said.
Other bankers said they did not trade overnight, adding that there were more one-month takers as the end of the year draws near.
The bankers said one-week rates narrowed slightly to between 10-1/8 and 10-1/4 percent against 10 and 10-7/16 percent on Sunday.
State-owned banks maintained their minimum overnight lending rate at 10 1/2 percent.
